title: Rotation-curve residuals reveal a suppressed acceleration branch in dwarf galaxies
efc_relevance: Two-branch RAR behaviour: SPARC high-acceleration arm vs LITTLE THINGS dwarfs with a suppressed intercept. Mirrors EFC's L1→L2 regime transition signature at low baryonic density and supplies a direct dwarf-galaxy test of EFC's MOND-limit/screening transition, in a regime where framework:VerlindeEmergent-2016 and framework:MOND-Milgrom1983 diverge most.
ledger_action: Add to Validation Ledger as SPARC regime-transition probe; update gap theory-multicomponent-sparc-universality with LITTLE THINGS dwarf-arm row; required head-to-head ΔAIC vs framework:VerlindeEmergent-2016, framework:MOND-Milgrom1983 and framework:Weyl-geometric-Harko2019.
